repository.scope: Single-player Unity WebGL first playable; one SignalGarden scene; desktop Chrome/Edge target; no multiplayer, network, progression, or production promotion.

desktopChromeForeground.method: Visible Codex Chrome extension session against the local nested host preview; canvas remained focused and the harness reported 30/30 seconds.
desktopChromeForeground.classification: Local evidence only; the mean gate is at least 60 fps, while the one-second minimum is informational.

pauseResume.method: Escape produced the readable Paused state and a second Escape restored Ready in the same desktop Chrome session.

localWarmReloadTimeToInteractive.method: Visible local nested preview reload with the existing candidate cached; this is a warm-cache observation, not a cold or production CDN qualification.

limitations: Headless CDP runs are automated diagnostics and do not satisfy independently observed foreground Chrome or Edge qualification.
Timings are local-only and do not qualify production CDN time to interactive.
These runs do not measure browser-tab working set, physical focus loss, screen-reader behavior, or fresh-player comprehension.

desktopChromeForeground.reason: An independently observed owner Chrome run remains open; the recorded local Chrome result is not substituted.

desktopEdgeForeground.reason: An independently observed owner Edge run remains open.

localColdTimeToInteractive.reason: A cold-cache local measurement remains open; the existing warm-cache result is recorded separately.

browserWorkingSet.reason: The game tab working set has not been measured with an operating-system process view.

physicalFocusLoss.reason: A real browser window or tab focus interruption remains open.

screenReader.reason: External screen-reader operation remains an owner-observed gate.

humanBenchmark.reason: Five fresh-player sessions have not been recorded.
